claim_scope_note: Promotion-gate certificate ONLY for C-PARAM-INHERIT (registry status EXPERIMENTAL; lane owners graph+product). This packet does NOT run the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark, does NOT compare COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RETRIEVAL arms (the parent handoff explicitly excludes a fourth re-run of the mandatory-discovery deterministic REST certificate; the Director mandate funds the promotion gate only), does NOT advance C-PARAM-INHERIT to VALIDATED (its next gate is still 'learn on resource A, succeed on never-observed B against cold/replay/retrieval baselines', unfunded until readiness conditions (2)+(3)), and does NOT measure economics. Measured object: whether the already-audited parameterized mechanism carrier (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 audit PASS) can be installed byte-identically at the shipping kernel path src/spider/kernel.py with a binding positive/negative certificate and honest inherited-path counters, so that promotion of the carrier to the shipping kernel is ENABLED on independent audit PASS, discharging the flagship benchmark's blocker B1.
question: Can the already-audited parameterized mechanism carrier be installed byte-identically at the shipping kernel path src/spider/kernel.py with a binding pre-freeze positive/negative certificate: (a) positive - distill_parameterized over >=3 induction observations resolves EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound non-null action at confidence 0.9 -> deterministic fixture execute status 200 -> verify true on an UNSEEN held-out identifier; (b) negative - refuse out-of-support / missing-parameter / wrong-intent bindings with a recorded reason and a null bound action, returning exactly ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN for the no-applicable-mechanism case; (c) honest inherited-path counters (retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts); (d) installed identity equal to the frozen carrier git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 - such that promotion is enabled ONLY on independent audit PASS, discharging blocker B1?
hypothesis: The audited carrier, when installed byte-identically at src/spider/kernel.py (bytes == git blob b15ed848 / sha256 718efa6a...), passes all five certificate clauses: D0-IDENTITY (pre-install kernel is the literal 46929b3a... or an already-installed carrier; post-install file equals the frozen blob), D1-POSITIVE (>=3 induction observations on the deterministic localhost HTTP fixture distill a parameterized mechanism with parameter_slots=['item'], induced support ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$, confidence 0.9, which resolves an UNSEEN single-digit-suffix identifier (item-007) EXECUTABLE with a non-null correctly bound action; executing it returns fixture status 200; verify returns true), D2-NEGATIVE (out-of-support item-010/item-999/item-xyz and missing-parameter bindings refused with EXPLORE + recorded reason + null bound action; wrong-intent delete_item and no-applicable never_seen_intent return EXACTLY ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN with recorded reason + null bound action), D3-COUNTERS (retrieval_calls/verification_calls/repair_attempts equal the invocation transcript; model_calls==0 and model_tokens==0 because the path is credential-free), and D4-CONTROLS (B-LITERAL-KERNEL ablation from git blob cfec9866 lacks distill_parameterized so the positive certificate is impossible without the installed carrier; PC-EXACT-REPLAY resolves all 5 training ids EXECUTABLE; the existing test_kernel regression suite passes 3/3 on the installed carrier). The certificate then PASSES and promotion is enabled only on an independent audit PASS; a FAIL on a correctly installed carrier is a valid bounded negative that refuses promotion and records the exact blocker.
falsifier: FALSIFIES (valid scientific negative, status COMPLETE) on a correctly installed carrier (D0 PASS) if any outcome-bearing clause fails: (1) D1-POSITIVE: no/incorrect mechanism distilled, or held-out item-007 does not resolve EXECUTABLE at confidence 0.9 with a non-null correctly bound action, or bound-action execute status != 200, or verify != true; (2) D2-NEGATIVE: any of the 7 refusal probes returns bound_action != null, an empty reason, a wrong status class (out-of-support/missing-parameter must be EXPLORE with the correct reason; wrong-intent/no-applicable must be exactly UNKNOWN); (3) D3-COUNTERS: retrieval_calls/verification_calls/repair_attempts differ from the invocation transcript, or model_calls != 0 or model_tokens != 0; (4) D4-CONTROLS: B-LITERAL-KERNEL has distill_parameterized (attribution broken), PC-EXACT-REPLAY < 5/5 EXECUTABLE, or regression != 3/3 passing. MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (never FALSIFIES) for identity/binding/infrastructure failures: pre-install kernel is neither the literal nor an already-installed carrier (unknown shipping-path state), carrier source sha != 718efa6a..., post-install file sha != 718efa6a... (byte mismatch, stop trigger: do not test a substituted carrier), git objects missing, fixture failure, or V8 freeze-binding mismatch (freeze.json missing/unreadable, prereg hash mismatch, runner source != FROZEN RUNNER block, freeze artifact hash mismatch).

measurement_validity: V1-DETERMINISM: the fixture is a stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer bound to 127.0.0.1:0 (ephemeral port); responses are fixed JSON {'type':'item','id':<id>,'data':'res:'+<id>} with status 200 for /api/items/<id> and 404 otherwise; no RNG, no wall-clock, no external network. The induced support and confidence are arithmetic functions of the 5 induction observations (probe: support ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$, confidence exactly 0.9).

V2-CREDENTIAL-FREE: model_calls == 0 and model_tokens == 0 are ASSERTED in D3; the only HTTP activity is urllib to the loopback fixture (recorded separately); no API keys, no browser, no external egress.

V3-IDENTITY-THREE-PART: (i) pre-install file sha in {46929b3a... (literal), 718efa6a... (already-installed carrier)} else BLOCKED; (ii) carrier source sha == 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72; (iii) post-install file bytes == git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 && file sha == 718efa6a... Any violation -> BLOCKED with exact reason.

V4-STOP-TRIGGER (mandate): if the carrier cannot be installed byte-identically or D0 fails, the runner records the exact promotion blocker and exits BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID BEFORE any certificate measurement; the certificate is never re-run against a substituted carrier (verified in DESIGN probe: substituted carrier -> BLOCKED, kernel untouched).

V5-HELD-OUT-INSIDE-SUPPORT (satisfiability guard): the positive held-out identifier must be UNSEEN but inside the induced support (single-digit id-suffix, e.g. item-007); the multi-digit item-010 is the audited failure-mode id and is used as the OUT-of-support negative. DESIGN probe on the frozen carrier: support ^item\-00[0-9]{1}$ accepts item-007, rejects item-010/item-999/item-xyz.

V6-REFUSAL-SEMANTICS: every refusal probe must have bound_action None, a non-empty non-null reason string, and status != EXECUTABLE; out-of-support and missing-parameter refusals must be ResolutionStatus.EXPLORE with the correct reason class ('support' / 'parameter'); wrong-intent and no-applicable must be EXACTLY ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN. Verified reachable in the DESIGN probe (all 7 probes).

V7-TRANSCRIPT-HONESTY: retrieval_calls must equal the number of resolve/rebind calls in the recorded invocation transcript, verification_calls the number of verify calls, repair_attempts the number of rebind calls; no counter is incremented without a real kernel call (probe: retrieval=9, verify=1, repair=1 after the full certificate path, transcript-consistent).

V8-FREEZE-BINDING (EXECUTE mode): (A) sha256(prereg.md) == freeze.json.hashes['prereg.md']; (B) the running orchestration source (__file__) equals the FROZEN RUNNER block inside the hash-bound prereg.md (normalized only for a trailing newline and CRLF); (C) sha256 of every artifact in freeze.json.artifact_hashes matches (pyproject.toml, src/spider/__init__.py, src/spider/models.py, src/spider/registry.py, tests/test_kernel.py; src/spider/kernel.py is deliberately NOT an artifact - it IS the treatment object whose identity is pinned by the two git blobs). Freeze.json missing/unreadable -> BLOCKED; any mismatch -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Verified in DESIGN probe (tampered artifact hash -> BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID).
V9-REGRESSION: tests/test_kernel.py (3 tests) must pass on the installed carrier (probe: 3/3 OK).

V10-ABLATION-ATTRIBUTION: B-LITERAL-KERNEL is loaded from the frozen literal git blob in a hermetic temp package with the same models/registry; if it has distill_parameterized the attribution logic is broken (D4 FAIL).

decision_rule.primary_metric: M-CERT-PASS (binary conjunction of D0..D4 with V8 enforced at EXECUTE)

D0-IDENTITY.definition: pre-install sha in {LITERAL 46929b3a..., CARRIER 718efa6a...}; carrier source sha == 718efa6a...; post-install file bytes == git blob b15ed848... and file sha == 718efa6a...
D0-IDENTITY.outcome_fail: BLOCKED, outcome=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, exact promotion blocker recorded (stop trigger; never test substituted carrier).

D1-POSITIVE.definition: >=3 induction observations (5 in this bank: item-001..005) -> distill_parameterized -> mechanism with slots ['item'], induced support, confidence == 0.9; resolve on UNSEEN held-out item-007 -> EXECUTABLE with non-null bound_action whose url contains item-007; executing bound action -> fixture status 200; verify(mechanism_id, observed_state, params) == true.

D2-NEGATIVE.definition: 7 probes: 3 out-of-support ids (item-010, item-999, item-xyz) -> EXPLORE + reason containing 'support' + null action; missing {} and {'wrong_key':'x'} -> EXPLORE + reason containing 'parameter' + null action; wrong-intent delete_item -> EXACTLY UNKNOWN + reason + null action; no-applicable never_seen_intent -> EXACTLY UNKNOWN + reason + null action. All 7: bound_action null and reason non-empty.

D3-COUNTERS.definition: retrieval_calls == #resolve + #rebind in transcript; verification_calls == #verify in transcript; repair_attempts == #rebind in transcript; model_calls == 0; model_tokens == 0; rebind path exercises repair_attempts increment (probe).

D4-CONTROLS.definition: B-LITERAL-KERNEL has no distill_parameterized; PC-EXACT-REPLAY 5/5 EXECUTABLE; regression 3/3 tests pass on installed carrier.

V8-FREEZE-BINDING.definition: EXECUTE mode: freeze.json present and readable; (A) prereg sha match; (B) runner source == FROZEN RUNNER block; (C) freeze artifact hashes match. Probe mode (EXP_PROBE_MODE=1, hermetic satisfiability probe only) records UNBOUND-RUN and does not fabricate the check.
V8-FREEZE-BINDING.outcome_fail: BLOCKED, outcome=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (binding is a validity gate, not a negative result).

decision_rule.overall_outcome_mapping: status=BLOCKED with outcome=MEASUREMENT_INVALID if D0/V8/infrastructure fails (pre-install unknown state, carrier sha mismatch, post-install byte mismatch, git objects missing, freeze.json missing/mismatch, fixture failure). Else status=COMPLETE with outcome=SUPPORTS if D1..D4 all PASS; outcome=FALSIFIES if any of D1..D4 fails on a correctly installed carrier (valid bounded negative: promotion refused, exact blocker recorded, no re-run on substituted carrier). Precedence: MEASUREMENT_INVALID > FALSIFIES > SUPPORTS.

The claim-bearing certificate is NOT measured in DESIGN.
decision_rule.promotion_semantics: Certificate PASS is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT for promotion: promotion of the parameterized carrier to the shipping kernel is ENABLED only on certificate PASS AND independent audit PASS (mandate). This packet does not itself promote anything; a DIRECTOR verdict grants promotion. C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL in ALL branches of this packet.

product_consequence_positive: Certificate SUPPORTS + independent audit PASS -> promotion of the audited parameterized carrier to the shipping kernel src/spider/kernel.py is ENABLED (a DIRECTOR verdict grants it), readiness condition (1) for the flagship C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark is DISCHARGED (blocker B1 resolved), and reviewers no longer see a mechanism only in a lane branch. C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL (its VALIDATED gate still requires the unfunded four-arm benchmark under readiness (2)+(3)); the claim is not advanced by this packet.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIES on a correctly installed carrier -> promotion REFUSED, shipped kernel remains the literal 46929b3a... version, B1 stays open, the flagship match cannot honestly run; EXECUTE records the exact frozen blocker (clause + observed values). BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID -> promotion REFUSED and the exact operational blocker recorded (unknown pre-install state, identity mismatch, git object missing, freeze binding failure, fixture failure); infrastructure failures are never repackaged as scientific negatives. In every negative branch C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL and the four-arm benchmark remains unfunded.
